dispositions.excerpt: A Turn MAY carry an advisory `cacheLineage` hint identifying the Turn and prompt prefix it…
dispositions.reason: The document denies this field correctness semantics in the same breath it introduces it — `Purely advisory; no correctness semantics.` — so there is no behaviour a conformance atom could require. The MAY is a permission over an optional hint, and the cost figure is rationale for why the hint gets a field at all. If a later edition gives `cacheLineage` any effect on a Turn, this digest stops matching and the exemption reopens.
